titulo: On first listen, the Sonos Beam Ultra sounds great
cuerpo: Sonos unveiled a bunch of new stuff today at its open house event. There's the $699 Beam Ultra soundbar and the $449 Ace Ultra headphones, plus several under-the-hood app updates (some coming sooner than others).
